module_title: Superlatives - Lakes, Waterfalls, Deserts, and Coastlines
introduction: This intermediate tier deep-dives into water bodies (freshwater vs. saltwater lakes), the tallest waterfalls, massive deserts, and extensive coastlines. These facts form the core of geography-based static GK in TCS-patterned exams.

core_concepts.title: Largest Lakes in the World
core_concepts.description: The largest lake in the world (saltwater) is the Caspian Sea. The largest freshwater lake by surface area is Lake Superior (North America). The deepest lake in the world is Lake Baikal (Russia).

core_concepts.title: Largest Lakes in India
core_concepts.description: India's largest saltwater lake (and lagoon) is Chilika Lake (Odisha). The largest freshwater lake is Wular Lake (Jammu & Kashmir). The longest lake in India is Vembanad Lake (Kerala).

core_concepts.title: Highest Waterfalls
core_concepts.description: The highest waterfall in the world is Angel Falls (Venezuela). In India, the highest 'plunge' waterfall is Jog/Gersoppa Falls (Karnataka - Sharavati River), but the highest tiered waterfall overall is Kunchikal Falls (Karnataka - Varahi River).

core_concepts.title: Deserts of the World
core_concepts.description: The largest hot desert in the world is the Sahara Desert (Africa). The largest desert in Asia is the Gobi Desert (Mongolia/China). The largest desert in India is the Thar Desert (Rajasthan).

important_entities.name: Greenland
important_entities.significance: Geographically part of North America, but politically an autonomous territory of Denmark.

important_entities.name: Andes
important_entities.significance: Stretches along the western coast of South America.

important_entities.name: Canada
important_entities.significance: Canada holds the global record for the longest coastline. In India, the state with the longest coastline is Gujarat.

trap_alerts_and_exceptions.explanation: If a question simply asks for the 'Largest Desert in the World' without specifying 'hot', and 'Antarctica' is in the options, Antarctica is the correct answer (it is a polar cold desert). If Antarctica is missing, choose Sahara.

Answer keys vary by commission. Kunchikal Falls (455m) is technically the highest tiered waterfall. However, many older textbooks and exam boards still consider Jog Falls (253m) as the answer because it is the highest untiered 'plunge' fall. Check the options carefully.

mnemonics_and_tricks.explanation: Lake Superior = Largest Freshwater Lake in the World.

mnemonics_and_tricks.memory_phrase: A deep lake can be your 'Kaal' (Death)
mnemonics_and_tricks.explanation: Lake Bai'kal' = Deepest lake in the world.

exam_strategy_tips: 'Match the Following' questions pairing lakes or waterfalls with their respective Indian states (e.g., Vembanad with Kerala, Chilika with Odisha) are extremely common. Memorize these pairings.
